reason: The studio's category union and write-allowlist had no way to express or display a 'friction' kind, so the surface could not see an artifact type it had to.
A shipped coverage command parses .tsx as ScriptKind.TS and therefore returns the same understated count to every caller who runs it.
The ADR-NNNN token cannot distinguish a session-local allocate-late placeholder from the corpus's generic any-ADR pattern, so the convention itself cannot express what the substitution needed to see.
An existing build verb performs an incorrect write on the launching session's presence row, re-declaring and then flipping it to done for every caller using the standard --real route.
The spawned builders ended their turn before the objective was reached, waiting for a notification that would never arrive, and needed an external nudge to continue.
The launch path without the tsx loader boots successfully and then 500s with an error naming a workspace package, a misleading failure any caller invoking vite directly reproduces.
The shipped filter command exits 0 on a package that does not exist, so the proof command cannot go red and the build chain halts with a verdict that misnames the cause for every caller.
A strict wire shape behind a deliberately fail-silent writer is a shipped bad default that discards every usage event on any additive producer field, with no red anywhere.
No mechanism exists to invalidate or re-check a brief's point-in-time existence premise against the live store, so a sibling's concurrent landing silently discharged the mandate.
The shipped check:coverage rung maps a contract to a test title rather than its clauses, returning the same over-claiming N/N to every capability that runs it.
The gate's ordering places the ten-second check:declared rung behind typecheck and the full test sweep, a shipped sequencing default that makes a cheap fix cost a whole gate re-run.
The fence for every cross-surface mirror other than GET /api/docs simply does not exist, so the /api/activity drift had no guard to catch it.
No claim, mutex or conflict check exists for the friction queue at all, so concurrent adjudicator seats drained and overwrote the same items unrefused.
The shipped check:corpus-content rung scores drift per-repo rather than per-author, so it returns the same false red to any session landing beside a corpus editor.
An existing command leaves the house @path convention unresolved and performs a wholesale destructive record replacement, reporting success either way.
The install verb computes an absolute hook path into a mutable checkout without verifying the script exists or is post-flip, so it can register a wall that enforces nothing.
Node/tsx resolves module format and workspace specifiers from the script's own directory, so a scratchpad-resident script fails for platform resolution reasons the error messages never name.
sheet.py composes cells without reading the per-dir render-meta.json that already records the flags, so the shipped compositor silently produces two-variable comparisons.
renderArcRollup fixes parked work last behind an ever-growing increment log, a shipped ordering default that makes the actionable section unreachable under any output truncation.
The AUTHOR_TEST turn ceiling is a shipped budget that exhausted twice on a trivially isolatable unit, promoting no patch.
The probe's own stable-picture predicate ran but measured the wrong property, admitting frames whose visual inputs had changed, and was fixed by re-authoring the protocol.
The authoring session published a steering comparative claim without checking it against two artifacts already in the store, both halves being false on the day it was written.
The arc lifecycle surface is recomputed from the increment log alone and cannot see chip-carried work, so it cannot represent remaining work that was chipped.
The shipped check reports only the routine 'stale' signature while already holding the budget fact, so its documented remedy is wrong for this case for every caller.
No edge, tag, check or curator mechanism exists that can detect a later ADR semantically falsifying an earlier ADR's prescribed build address.
gate:bg's detach is conditional on nothing holding stdout, so the shipped launcher silently dies under the natural pipe, with a symptom indistinguishable from documented starvation.
The pass's own verify.py check ran but asserted against the branch diff rather than the promise, so it reported a broken promise about unrelated work.
No kind-agnostic or field-agnostic text search over the corpus exists, so the absence sweep the task required cannot be performed at all.
The shipped capture harness's non-vacuity guard counts opaque pixels and therefore reports a clean closure over a missing prop for every caller that runs it.
A teardown race in an existing test's temp-fixture cleanup reds the suite for branches that touch nothing near it, independent of the branch's code.
capture.mjs hardcodes a steady-state 30s navigation budget with no override, a shipped bad default that refuses on every first run in a fresh worktree.
The machine's PATH, not any repository code, is the cause: Bun is installed at the CI-pinned version but unreachable from either shell.
The uat run path ships without the memoization its sibling adopt path has, so the same deterministic command is re-observed per leg for every caller.
A shipped probe returns the same false FAIL on any vault-provisioned box and prints a fix hint prescribing an invariant a later ADR retired.
The shipped --rerun-failed comparison asserts 'nothing was fixed' from git alone and returns that confident wrong verdict to every session whose fix was a live-store write.
The agent's own measurement instrument ran with arguments in the wrong order and published a plausible but wrong sweep, a defect specific to how this probe was written.
The shipped rung's closing message names only two remedies and omits the correct third, steering every session it reds toward tests that cannot work or a dead-code disable comment.
The committed driver defaults to an asset URL that is not in the repo, so the published reproduce command 404s for every reader on a fresh checkout.
A shipped gate rung fails to take its skip branch on a fresh worktree, reddening the gate identically for any branch regardless of content.
A flag interaction re-arms the parked-entry fence and breaks the documented --discharged-by exemption, with a refusal prescribing a wrong remedy to every caller.
